title: 37th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/37/2024).

Question time: Kanditheemu MP Ameen Faisal asks the Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Thoriq Ibrahim, when 60 households in Sh. Kanditheemu will be allowed to install solar panels, after Fenaka refused their net-metering applications saying the 60 percent domestic share of capacity under the Net Metering Regulation is already used up.
First reading of the Bill amending the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangolhi North MP Ibrahim Mohamed.
Public Finance Committee report on the Auditor General's Office budget for 2025.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the environment minister on blocked rooftop solar in Kanditheemu, introduced the Export Import Act amendment, and took up a committee report on the Auditor General's 2025 budget.
